text.tspan: What the router rewrites (ports from the tested run)
web has no route back: curl (28)
the P in PAT: the port changes too
the laptop logs the real client
Only the first packet of a connection (the SYN) goes through the nat table: each rule counted 1 packet, 60 bytes.
Every later packet is translated from the conntrack entry (conntrack -L shows both directions).
